MOVEMENT.TOO_FAR: {name} can move at most {run} m per turn (run); this move makes {total} m.
MOVEMENT.SETTING_LIMIT_HINT: Players cannot move a token further than its run distance during its turn. The GM is never limited.
ACTIONS.HALF: Half action (click to mark or clear)
ACTIONS.TURN_ENDED: {name} has spent their actions — next turn.
ACTIONS.SETTING_AUTO_END: End the turn when actions are spent
ACTIONS.SETTING_AUTO_END_HINT: Attacks, aiming, focus powers and movement mark half actions of the current combatant in the combat tracker; when both are spent the turn passes to the next combatant.
ACTIONS.PINNED: Pinned: a single half action this turn
ACTIONS.REACTION_DEFENSIVE: Extra Evasion reaction of Defensive Stance (click to mark or clear)
COMBAT_ACTION.NO_GM: No GM is connected: the effects of this action will not be applied.
COMBAT_ACTION.NOT_OWNER: You do not own this character.
COMBAT_ACTION.NOT_ENOUGH: Only {n} half action(s) left this turn.
COMBAT_ACTION.NEED_TARGET: Target exactly one other token first.
COMBAT_ACTION.NO_MELEE_WEAPON: No melee weapon (an unarmed attack counts as a melee weapon item).
COMBAT_ACTION.NOT_GRAPPLING: The grapple partner was not found.
COMBAT_ACTION.EVADE_FIRST: The target may evade (Dodge or Parry) before this is applied.
COMBAT_ACTION.ALL_OUT_HINT: Melee attack at +30; no Evasion reactions until your next turn; cannot be combined with Aim.
COMBAT_ACTION.DEFENSIVE_HINT: No attack. Until your next turn: an extra Evasion reaction (only Evasion), opponents get -20 to Weapon Skill against you.
COMBAT_ACTION.CAUTIOUS_HINT: Must be the first action of the turn: -10 to your WS and BS tests this turn, +10 to Evasion until your next turn.
COMBAT_ACTION.FEINT_HINT: Opposed Weapon Skill test; if you win, the target cannot evade your next Standard Attack this turn.
COMBAT_ACTION.FEINT_WON: {name} cannot evade the next Standard Attack this turn.
COMBAT_ACTION.MANOEUVRE_HINT: Opposed Weapon Skill test; if you win, the opponent moves 1 m in a direction of your choice (not into a person or an obstacle), you may follow 1 m.
COMBAT_ACTION.MANOEUVRE_WON: Move {name} 1 m in a direction of your choice.
COMBAT_ACTION.KNOCKDOWN_HINT: Opposed Strength test (+10 after a Charge or a move): the target falls prone; with 2+ DoS you may strike instead (1d5-3+SB impact, 1 fatigue); if the target wins with 2+ DoS you fall.
COMBAT_ACTION.KNOCKDOWN_CHOICE: Two or more degrees: knock {name} down or strike instead.
COMBAT_ACTION.STRIKE_DONE: {name} takes {damage} impact damage to the body and a level of fatigue.
COMBAT_ACTION.STUN_HINT: Unarmed or with a melee weapon: Hard (-20) Weapon Skill test; on a hit 1d10+SB against the target's TB + head armour: stunned for the difference in rounds and one level of fatigue.
COMBAT_ACTION.STUNNED: {name} is stunned for {rounds} round(s) and gains a level of fatigue.
COMBAT_ACTION.GRAPPLE_HINT: Standard Attack (+10) to seize the target; it may evade. On a hit both are grappled and you control the grapple.
COMBAT_ACTION.GRAPPLE_DAMAGE_HINT: Opposed Strength test: if you win, 1d5-3+SB impact damage to the body and a level of fatigue.
COMBAT_ACTION.GRAPPLE_DAMAGE_WON: {name} takes {damage} impact damage to the body and a level of fatigue.
COMBAT_ACTION.GRAPPLE_HOLDS: {name} takes no damage but stays grappled.
COMBAT_ACTION.GRAPPLE_THROW_HINT: Opposed Strength test: if you win, the opponent falls prone; you may end the grapple or keep it (+10 to further opposed tests while he tries to stand).
COMBAT_ACTION.GRAPPLE_PUSH_HINT: Opposed Strength test: if you win, push the opponent 1 m plus 1 m per degree (no more than your half move); move with him or let go.
COMBAT_ACTION.GRAPPLE_PUSH_WON: Push {name} up to {metres} m (half move {max} m at most).
COMBAT_ACTION.GRAPPLE_STAND_HINT: Both on the ground: stand up; opposed Strength test to raise the opponent with you.
COMBAT_ACTION.GRAPPLE_STAND_ALONE: You stand up, the opponent stays down.
COMBAT_ACTION.GRAPPLE_RELEASE_HINT: The controller ends the grapple (free action).
COMBAT_ACTION.GRAPPLE_BREAK_HINT: Opposed Strength test against the controller: if you win, you are free and may take any half action.
COMBAT_ACTION.GRAPPLE_SLIP_HINT: Acrobatics test (+0): on a success you slip free and may take any half action.
COMBAT_ACTION.GRAPPLE_CONTROL_HINT: Opposed Strength test: if you win, you control the grapple and may use one controller option, but no other half action.
COMBAT_ACTION.STAND_UP_HINT: Stand up from prone (also mount, dismount, enter or leave a vehicle).
COMBAT_ACTION.DELAY_HINT: The turn ends now; any one half action may be taken before your next turn (not a second Attack or Concentration action).
COMBAT_ACTION.OVERWATCH_HINT: Guard a 45° kill zone with a Standard Attack or a burst and its trigger until your next turn; targets entering it test against Pinning (+0). Any action or reaction ends it.
COMBAT_ACTION.TACTICAL_ADVANCE_HINT: Move up to your half move from cover to cover; you keep the benefit of the cover you left while moving.
COMBAT_ACTION.DISENGAGE_HINT: Break off from melee and take a half move; the opponents get no free Standard Attack against you.
TARGET_STATE.DEFENSIVE_NOTE: Target {name} is in a Defensive Stance: -20 included
TWO_WEAPON.LABEL: Two weapons: this and a second attack with the other weapon ({penalty} each, one half action)
TWO_WEAPON.TYPE_MELEE: Two-weapon fighting in melee allows Standard, Swift or Lightning Attacks.
TWO_WEAPON.TYPE_RANGED: Two-weapon fighting at range allows Standard Attacks, Semi-Auto or Full Auto Bursts.
TWO_WEAPON.ONE_HANDED: Only one-handed ranged weapons (pistols) can be used for two-weapon fighting; others only with a penalty if at all.
COVER.TITLE: Cover
COVER.LOCATIONS_HINT: Hit locations behind the cover (firing from cover: legs and body):
COVER.ABSORBED: The cover of {name} ({ap} AP) took {hits} hit(s).
COVER.WORN: It is worn down to {ap} AP.
ENVIRONMENT.TITLE: Combat environment
ENVIRONMENT.HINT: Darkness by lighting: the target in a darkness source, or at darkness level 0.5+ without light; darkvision and light amplification ignore it. Regions with «Modify Movement Cost» mark difficult terrain under a token (cost over 1: -10, 3 or more: -30).
ENVIRONMENT.DARKVISION_NOTE: Darkness, but the attacker sees in the dark: no penalty
COMBAT_ACTION.COVER_HINT: Take cover or change it: its armour points and the hit locations it hides (table 7-4). Moving into cover is a normal move.
CONDITIONS.PRONE_WS: You are prone: {modifier} to Weapon Skill included
CONDITIONS.PRONE_EVASION: You are prone: {modifier} to Evasion included
CONDITIONS.PINNED_BS: You are pinned: {modifier} to Ballistic Skill included
CONDITIONS.FATIGUE_NOTE: Fatigue {fatigue}: {list} count half (already in the values)
CONDITIONS.FIRE_NOTE: You are on fire: Willpower test at the start of each turn to act normally
CONDITIONS.GRAPPLED_NOTE: You are in a grapple: only grapple actions
CONDITIONS.FATIGUE_UNCONSCIOUS: {name} has {fatigue} levels of fatigue, over the threshold of {threshold}: falls unconscious for {minutes} minutes (10 − TB). On waking up fatigue drops to the Toughness bonus ({toughness}).
CONDITIONS.FATIGUE_DEATH: {name} has {fatigue} levels of fatigue, over twice the threshold of {threshold}: the character dies.
EVASION.TITLE: Evasion
EVASION.PROBLEMS: By the rules {name} cannot evade now:
EVASION.OWN_TURN: it is their own turn — reactions are used outside it
EVASION.ALL_OUT: made an All Out Attack — no Evasion until their next turn
EVASION.NO_REACTION: the reaction of this round is already spent
EVASION.FEINT: lost a Feint — cannot evade this Standard Attack
FIRE.TITLE: On fire
FIRE.TEXT: {name} burns: {damage} energy damage to the body, ignoring armour, and one level of fatigue.
FIRE.EXTINGUISH: Put out the fire (Agility −20, Full Action)
FIRE.PANIC: {name} failed the Willpower test: can only flail and scream (Full Action).
STUN.LOSES_TURN: {name} is stunned and loses the turn.
FEAR.CARD_TEXT: Characters who see the creature test Willpower against Fear
TABLES.NO_TEXT: No table text registered: look the result up in the rulebook.
TABLES.RF_EFFECT: Righteous Fury: critical effect (not critical damage):
TABLES.RF_TROOP: Troop NPCs simply die from Righteous Fury (core p. 280).
TABLES.NO_MODIFIERS: No modifiers from psyker class, sustained powers or Warp Conduit.
TABLES.FAVOURED_BY_WARP: Favoured by the Warp: second roll, choose one result
TABLES.PERILS_DAEMONIC: Daemonic psyker: Perils of the Warp do not affect the psyker, but affect everyone else.
TABLES.SHAKEN: Outside combat: the character is shaken, −10 to tests that require concentration while in the area of the Fear.
TABLES.TRAUMA_TEST: Insanity passed a multiple of 10: Trauma test.
TABLES.WARP_SHOCK: Warp Shock: Corruption equal to the Fear rating (core p. 353)
FEAR.IMMUNE: {name} is not frightened by {source} ({rating}): Insanity bonus {bonus} is at least twice the Fear rating (core p. 353).
FATE_POINTS.DIALOG_STATE: Fate points: {value} / {max}. Spending a point is a free action (core p. 357).
FATE_POINTS.DIALOG_HINT: Re-roll a test or add a degree of success: right-click the roll card in chat. +10 to a test: tick the box in the roll dialog before rolling.
FATE_POINTS.DIALOG_NOTHING: Nothing to spend Fate on right now.
FATE_POINTS.CONFIRM_BURN: Burn a Fate point? The Fate threshold drops by 1 for good; the character survives what nearly killed him, but is out of the fight.
FATE_POINTS.CONFIRM_WILL_NOT_DIE: It Will Not Die!: the character cannot burn Fate, but survives as if he had and gains 1d10+5 Corruption points.
FATE_POINTS.NO_EFFECT: The point is spent without effect.
FATE_POINTS.BURN_NOTE: The character survives, but is incapacitated and out of the fight; with critical damage he suffers every effect except death (core p. 357).
FATE_POINTS.NOT_RETURNED: {item}: {roll} against Corruption {target}, the point is gone
FATE_POINTS.NO_THRESHOLD: {name} has no Fate threshold left to burn.
FATE_POINTS.NOT_IN_COMBAT: {name} is not in the current combat.
FATE_POINTS.BONUS_APPLIED: Fate point: +10 included in the modifier
FATE_POINTS.BONUS_WASTED: Fate point spent for +10 without effect
MIND.DISORDER_HINT: Insanity {insanity}: a Minor disorder at 40, Severe at 60, Acute at 80 — a new one, or a worse degree of one the character has. The GM chooses, or lets the player choose.
MIND.DISORDER_NAME_HINT: Name of a disorder not on the list
MIND.DISORDER_SUPPRESS: Willpower test {modifier} to ignore it until the end of the encounter.

AREA.PICK_SPRAY: Click the direction of the spray on the map (right click or Esc to cancel)
AREA.PICK_ORIGIN: Click the point the spray starts from

PINNING.CARD_TEXT: Everyone in the kill zone tests Pinning (Willpower)
PINNING.NOT_IN_ZONE: {name} is not in the kill zone.
PINNING.NOT_OWNER: You do not own this character.
PINNING.RECOVER_TEXT: End of turn: Willpower test to stop being pinned (+30 in cover or if not shot at last turn)
MEDICAE.NO_PATIENT: No token to treat on this scene.
MEDICAE.TOO_SOON: {name} received first aid {hours} h ago: once per 24 hours.
MEDICAE.HEALED: {name} removes {amount} damage: {critical} critical, {wounds} wounds (now {damage} damage, {criticalLeft} critical).
MEDICAE.BLEEDING_FATIGUE: Blood Loss at the start of the turn: +1 Fatigue, now
MEDICAE.BLEEDING_DIE_HARD: Blood Loss at the start of the turn: Die Hard — Willpower test or +1 Fatigue

TARGET_STATE.HELPLESS_CHAT: Helpless target: automatic success, damage dice rolled twice

WEAPON_JAM.UNJAMMED: Jam cleared. The ammunition in the weapon is lost: reload
WEAPON_JAM.STILL_JAMMED: The weapon is still jammed, try again next round
WEAPON_JAM.IS_JAMMED: {weapon} is jammed and cannot fire. Try to clear the jam (Full Action, Ballistic Skill test)?
WEAPON_JAM.NOT_OWNER: You do not own this weapon
WEAPON_JAM.MISFIRE_DUD: the explosive fails to go off
WEAPON_JAM.MISFIRE_GRENADE: the explosive detonates, centred on the attacker!
WEAPON_JAM.MISFIRE_LAUNCHER: the explosive detonates in the barrel: half effect centred on the attacker, the weapon is destroyed!
